question: Will the US put boots on the ground in Iran before September?
resolution_criteria:
Resolution criteria:

This market will resolve to YES if, at any point before September 1, 2026, the United States deploys active-duty military ground forces ("boots on the ground") on sovereign Iranian territory (including mainland Iran and its sovereign islands, such as Kharg Island).

Otherwise, this market will resolve to NO.

Definitions & Clarifications:

"Boots on the ground": Defined as the physical presence of U.S. military personnel (including Army, Marines, or Special Operations Forces) on dry land within Iran's borders for combat, securing infrastructure, or other military operations.

Exclusions: The following events will not trigger a YES resolution:

Naval blockades, ship boardings, or maritime operations in the Persian Gulf or Strait of Hormuz that do not involve forces landing on Iranian territory.

Aerial operations, including manned or unmanned airstrikes.

U.S. aircrews or pilots entering Iranian territory solely due to their aircraft being shot down, or search-and-rescue teams deployed specifically to retrieve downed personnel.
research:
I found no credible report through 2026-08-19 of US ground forces deliberately on Iranian land. The one confirmed US presence on Iranian soil was the April 2026 F-15E crew rescue, and this question excludes search-and-rescue missions. My attempts to open full pages (Al Jazeera, NewsNation, GlobalSecurity, Polymarket, Wikipedia) were blocked by the proxy, so everything below comes from search-result summaries.

## 1. Resolution source
- No URL or official data source is named in the criteria. The question looks like a Polymarket-style market, and it would presumably be settled on credible media reporting. I could not find or open the market page for this exact question, so I can't report a current price or status.
- 2026-04-11: Some background on how Polymarket handled a similar market. In its earlier "US forces enter Iran by…" market, it ruled that the brief special-forces rescue of the downed pilot counted as entry. This question specifically excludes that kind of rescue. [The Week](https://www.theweek.in/news/middle-east/2026/04/11/amid-us-iran-stalemate-dollar269-million-question-divides-polymarket-did-american-forces-enter-tehran.amp.html)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. Searches found no seizure of Kharg Island and no special-forces raid on Iranian soil in July or August 2026, only airstrikes, plans and threats. [Foreign Policy](https://foreignpolicy.com/2026/07/24/us-ground-operation-iran-invasion-kharg-war-trump/)
- 2026-08-18: No US or Israeli strike inside Iran had been confirmed by CENTCOM as of 05:00 ET that day. The US had 18 military deaths since 2026-02-28 and no new deaths reported. [GlobalSecurity](https://www.globalsecurity.org/military/ops/iran-war-20260818.htm)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-18: Trump said no talks with Iran are underway or scheduled, and the UAE detected a "missile threat." [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/18/world/live-news/iran-war-trump)
- 2026-08-18: The Pentagon is weighing a smaller US military presence in the Gulf once the war ends. This is not yet a formal review. [Washington Post](https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-security/2026/08/18/pentagon-evaluating-smaller-us-military-presence-persian-gulf-after-iran-war/)
- 2026-08-17: The 60-day US-Iran ceasefire agreement (memorandum of understanding) signed on June 17 expired with no permanent deal. Iran's foreign minister said Iran had not decided to restart talks, while Qatar and Pakistan are still passing messages. Some outlets say Trump declared the agreement terminated on 2026-07-07. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/17/us-iran-memorandum-of-understanding-expires-how-and-why-it-fell-apart), [NewsNation](https://www.newsnationnow.com/world/us-iran-war-memorandum-of-understanding/)
- 2026-08-17: Iran signalled it is ready for "US ground operations." Its commanders have prepared defences for southern islands and coastal areas, including Kharg Island. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/17/iran-signals-readiness-for-us-ground-operations-as-mou-expires)
- 2026-07-25: According to a New York Post report, US officials were again considering a special operation to seize Iran's enriched uranium stockpile. [Kurdistan24](https://www.kurdistan24.net/en/story/928187/new-york-post-us-weighs-special-forces-raid-on-irans-nuclear-sites)
- 2026-07-24: Former officials said the US did not appear to be moving toward a major ground operation. Smaller actions, such as taking islands or special-forces raids, remained possible. [Foreign Policy](https://foreignpolicy.com/2026/07/24/us-ground-operation-iran-invasion-kharg-war-trump/)
- 2026-07-17: Citing the Wall Street Journal, WSWS reported that the White House had discussed sending ground forces, including seizing islands near the Strait of Hormuz. [WSWS](https://www.wsws.org/en/articles/2026/07/17/vdtb-j17.html)
- 2026-07-08: Trump said the US "may take over Kharg Island" after striking it. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/8/trump-says-us-may-take-over-kharg-island-heres-what-you-need-to-know)
- 2026-07-07: CENTCOM struck more than 80 targets in Iran and oil sanctions were reimposed. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/07/07/world/live-news/nato-summit-trump)
- 2026-06-11: Trump said the US would at some point seize Kharg Island. CNN reported that seizure plans had been drawn up and repeatedly shelved as too risky. [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/06/11/us-will-seize-and-control-irans-kharg-island-and-other-key-oil-facilities-trump-says)

## 4. Base rates
- The war began around 2026-02-28, about 172 days before 2026-08-19. In that time the only confirmed US presence on Iranian soil was the April F-15E rescue, which is excluded here. That means zero qualifying deliberate ground operations in roughly 5.5 months, despite repeated threats and planning. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_F-15E_rescue_operation_in_Iran)
- 2026-03 onward: Kharg Island seizure plans have existed since at least March and have been shelved repeatedly. Elements of the 82nd Airborne and a Marine amphibious group deployed to the region in March. [Military.com](https://www.military.com/benefits/2026/03/30/us-ground-forces-arrive-middle-east-iran-conflict-escalates.html), [PBS](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/what-experts-say-about-the-risks-of-u-s-seizing-irans-kharg-island)
- 2026-03 to 2026-04: Hegseth and Trump would not rule out ground troops, while several Republican lawmakers opposed them. [The Hill](https://thehill.com/policy/defense/5762676-boots-ground-iran-hegseth/), [Time](https://time.com/7382186/iran-ground-troops-trump/)

## 5. Other forecasts
- I could not find a current price for this exact question (deadline before September 1).
- Late March 2026: Polymarket priced US forces entering Iran by April 30 at 62% to 72%. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/commodities/articles/polymarket-bettors-put-62-odds-110006050.html)
- Mid-June 2026: Polymarket's stricter "invasion" market (US taking control of Iranian territory by 2026-12-31) fell to about 14% to 28% after a peak of 68% on 2026-03-29. [Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/polymarket-us-iran-invasion-odds-2027/)
- I found no Kalshi or Manifold prices and no expert probability estimates.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution (by 2026-09-01)
- The ceasefire agreement has lapsed and there are no talks. Whether US strikes resume and whether Iran escalates are the main things that could trigger an island seizure or a raid.
- Possible White House decisions on seizing Kharg Island or other islands, or on a raid to take the uranium stockpile. Both have been under discussion since June and July.
- Iranian attacks on US forces or shipping in the Strait of Hormuz; a vessel was hit by an unknown projectile on 2026-08-18. [GlobalSecurity](https://www.globalsecurity.org/military/ops/iran-war-20260818.htm)
- Any restart of mediation through Qatar or Pakistan, which would likely lower the risk.

**(e) Scenarios**
- **No:** The lapsed agreement leads to sporadic airstrikes and maritime incidents while mediators keep channels open. The administration keeps using the Kharg threat as leverage but does not commit troops before Sep 1. This is the most likely path.

**(f) From base rate to final**
- **Starting point:** about 4%.

- **Adjusting down:** I move down slightly because there are no signs of an imminent operation, no resumed strike campaign as of Aug 18, and the Pentagon is planning a drawdown. A covert raid might also go unreported before resolution.
- **Market anchor:** I found no market price for this exact question to use as an anchor.

Net, I land at about 5%.

Probability: 5%
